dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent white wing bar on the greater coverts showing high grayscale contrast against the dark gray-black feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible pale-white edges on folded secondary feathers providing moderate boundary sharpness against the darker primary bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, rectangular white patch on the posterior neck showing high contrast with the surrounding black and olive-green regions.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp color transition boundary between the black crown and olive-green mantle, bisected by a white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad white auricular patch (cheek) providing high contrast against the black head plumage.
